settings.title: Universal Remote
settings.subtitle: Manage buttons, learn codes through ESPHome and keep a portable backup.
settings.global_subtitle: Configure ESPHome for learning and enable detailed debug logging when troubleshooting.
settings.debug_hint: Logs detailed MQTT and transmission data such as request IDs, ProntoHex/raw codes, selected carrier codebook and quantization error. Leave disabled for normal operation.
settings.add_remote_hint: Add remotes from Devices > Add Device > Universal Remote.
settings.no_remotes: No remotes have been added yet.
settings.press_remote: Point the remote at the ESPHome receiver and briefly press the same button several times. Homey compares up to 5 captures and accepts the code as soon as 3 match closely enough. Learning waits up to 30 seconds.

repair.subtitle: Add, edit, learn, test or delete the buttons of this remote.
repair.no_buttons: This remote has no buttons yet.
repair.transmitter_notice: Learned ProntoHex/raw codes are mapped into a static timing codebook. This lets Homey send them dynamically through the Homey Bridge selected for this remote.
repair.backup_hint: Export and import use the same JSON field and apply only to this remote. Import replaces this remote's name and all buttons from the field; the Homey device ID and Bridge assignment stay unchanged.
repair.enter_backup: Paste a backup JSON into the text field first.
repair.confirm_import: Replace the complete current configuration of this remote with the backup in the text field?
repair.exported: Backup was placed in the text field and selected.
repair.imported: Backup was imported into this remote.
